# Apps by Steed

> bysteed.com is the home of the iPhone apps made by Steed: Shift, Stallion and AtlasDays. Each app has a product page, a privacy policy and a support page here; AtlasDays has its own site.

## Shift

An interval timer for workouts, for iPhone and iPad. Set work, rest and rounds, tap Start. Free, with no ads, paywall, subscription, account, analytics or tracking. Workouts stay on the device.

- [Shift](https://bysteed.com/shift/): product page, also in every App Store language under /shift/<code>/
- [Shift privacy policy](https://bysteed.com/shift/privacy/)
- [Shift support](https://bysteed.com/shift/support/): email shift@bysteed.com
- [Shift on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6805132734)

## Stallion

A training journal for Apple Health workouts, for iPhone. It shows each workout recorded by Apple Watch or another app and keeps a note per workout, or per day when a day has no workout. No account and no ads; notes stay on the iPhone, with optional backups to the user's own iCloud Drive. In English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Dutch, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian and Spanish. Free on the App Store, with one optional purchase.

- [Stallion](https://bysteed.com/stallion/): product page, also in each of its languages under /stallion/<code>/
- [Stallion privacy policy](https://bysteed.com/stallion/privacy/), also under /stallion/<code>/privacy/
- [Stallion support](https://bysteed.com/stallion/support/), also under /stallion/<code>/support/: email stallion@bysteed.com
- [Stallion on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6816050020)

## AtlasDays

Tracks visas, residency and travel days per country, including rules such as Schengen 90/180.

- [AtlasDays](https://atlasdays.app)
